data.body: AC evidence (Gerrit 1896 PS2, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1; 52 direct tests plus 3302 reconciler/interfaces tests green; check_config_ownership 0, make lint 0, typecheck 566, comment-hygiene 0). AC1 three confirmed 404s retire / a successful read resets -> test_note_absent_increments_and_retires_at_the_third_consecutive_404 (asserting non-retirement at 1 and 2) and test_clear_absent_resets_the_counter_after_a_successful_read (which then proves two further 404s do NOT retire, so the reset really restarted the count), plus test_retirement_survives_a_reload_through_the_repository. AC2 tombstones suppress recreation with an alert until explicit unretire -> test_note_create_suppressed_alerts_and_names_the_remedy (asserts the remedy names unretire), test_unretire_lifts_the_tombstone_from_both_the_set_and_the_file (durable across reload), test_unretire_emits_an_alert, test_unretire_of_an_unretired_key_is_an_idempotent_noop, plus tombstone-isolation tests proving retiring or lifting one of several leaves the others intact. AC3 fail-open/fail-closed boundaries -> test_corrupt_retired_file_fails_open_and_leaves_live_state_usable, test_corrupt_live_state_still_fails_closed, test_an_alert_write_failure_does_not_break_a_retirement. AC4 comment IDs append only when changed and legacy records readable without rewrite -> test_identical_re_record_performs_no_write_at_all (a WRITE-COUNTING oracle; the original byte-comparison version was a mutation-proven tautology because no timestamp is stamped, so an unconditional save re-serializes identical bytes) and test_legacy_store_without_the_comment_map_is_readable_without_rewrite. AC5 no threshold, stored field or public signature changes -> the pre-existing facade suites (test_binding_absence_lifecycle, test_binding_store_comment_ids, test_corrupt_state_guard, test_no_resurrection_after_confirmed_delete_3b5f) all pass UNMODIFIED, and every facade method is now a one-line delegate with an unchanged signature. CONFIG: _env_int, _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE and the RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE read moved with the policy they serve, sourcing preserved byte-identically (ambient os.environ, same defensive parse, default 3, clamp 1); BOTH config_ownership_exceptions.py rows retargeted to the binding_lifecycle.py path with MOVED-legacy rationales, stale L538/L110 prose corrected; ADR 0099 section 9 records the move as realized; docs/env-vars.md regenerated. binding_store.py 646 -> 539, binding_lifecycle.py 267 -> 495. FINDING: the docstring claim 'a key is never remapped to a different id' was FALSE on the reviewed base (the gate is equality-only, so a differing id overwrites and saves); corrected where it moved and pinned by test_a_differing_id_for_a_known_key_overwrites_and_saves rather than changing behavior. Follow-up filed: captious-hennish-mangabey.
